mapper.sql: b.id, b.bill_no, b.order_id, b.user_id, b.amount, b.type, b.payment_method, b.status, b.remark, b.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name as user_name, o.order_no FROM bill b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON b.order_id = o.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill (bill_no, order_id, user_id, amount, type, payment_method, status, remark) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{remark})
